name: @oge-ui/navigation
description: Signal-based Angular navigation family: OgeTreeView with flat or nested data and APG treeview keyboard support, OgeDrawer whose modality follows its layout mode, OgeStepper with async leave guards, OgeMenubar — a WAI-ARIA APG menubar with nested submenus and a container-width hamburger collapse — and OgeBreadcrumb with a container-width ellipsis collapse that keeps hidden crumbs reachable as links.
author: kaya2m
